guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.description: Sign in using one of the supported methods: Email — Privy creates an embedded non-custodial wallet for you. Google account — same flow as email, signed in with Gmail. guide.title: Earn Points from X Posts
guide.description: Onchain.cc runs a social scoring system that pays Colosseum points for posting about the platform on X. Tag the official @Onchaincc account so the AI scorer picks up your post. Quality, reach, and engagement determine the score on a 0–100 scale. Posts that share a real trade, include a screenshot of the terminal, or generate organic engagement score well. Spam and copy-paste content score near zer
